commands.name: help.read
commands.description: List nAudio commands with their parameter schemas and scopes, or describe one command. Start with doc.state (file.read) to see the project: tracks, clips, labels and selection.

command.description: An nAudio command id; omit to list all

commands.name: file.save
commands.description: Save the project where it lives (NakliOS storage when hosted). A new project is saved under its name in NakliOS storage, or in this browser when not hosted.

commands.name: file.save_as
commands.description: Save under a new name; the copy becomes the project you are editing. kind is naklios (hosted) or browser (standalone), default where it is now. A name already taken fails unless replace is true. Saving to this computer needs a person (File > Save as).

commands.name: file.open
commands.description: Show the Open page: Recent, then the projects in storage, then Browse this computer.

commands.name: file.new
commands.description: Show the New page (blank or a template).

commands.name: file.info
commands.description: The current project's name, where it is saved, and whether it has unsaved changes.

commands.name: assistant.ask
commands.description: Ask nAudio's assistant to do a job in the open project (for example build, rewrite or format it). It opens the Ask pane, starts at once and returns a job id; follow it with assistant.status.

request.description: What to do, in plain words

commands.name: assistant.status
commands.description: The state of nAudio's assistant job (the latest when job is omitted): running, done, failed, stopped or limit, with its last steps and summary.

commands.name: assistant.stop
commands.description: Stop nAudio's running assistant job.

commands.name: script.run
commands.description: Run nAudio commands in order as one undo step: steps [{ command, input }], command a dotted id such as select.set or effect.fade-in. A string "$N.key" in an input is step N's result field (1-based), e.g. "$1.track". Returns each step's result. If a step fails, nothing changes. Hard-to-undo, person-only and file commands run on their own, not in a script. At most 200 steps.

commands.name: view.snapshot
commands.description: A PNG picture of the project as the person sees it: a time ruler, each track's waveform with clip boundaries, labels and the selection, plus a text summary of tracks, clips, length and selection. Returns { dataUrl, width, height, summary }. Check your work with it before you finish.

end.description: Last second shown (default the project end)

commands.name: doc.describe
commands.description: A compact description of the whole project for planning: length, sample rate, selection, every track with its clips (seconds), labels, and how many transcript words and cut-list entries there are. Long lists are cut, with a count of what was left out.

commands.name: file.export
commands.description: Export a copy of the whole mix; the project stays where it is. Hosted, the copy goes to NakliOS storage under exports/; otherwise it downloads. From a menu or key it shows the File page at Export. file.export-audio takes bit depth, bitrate, chapters and selection only.
